#  11934 - English - Intermediate B1 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11934 - module is no longer offered from SS 2022**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **English - Intermediate B1**  |  
|  Englischkurs Sprachlevel B1   |  
| Department:  |  ZES - Language Centre   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Riebow, Ute 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 2 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  12   |  
| Learning Outcome:  | At the end of the module the students are able to understand contents from everyday topics like work, school or leisure expressed in clear standard language. They can write short texts concerning topics of personal interests, describe events or goals and give short explanations for opinions or proceedings. They will also be able to prepare and take part in job interviews and discuss topics of their own professional area of expertise.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Reading and understanding texts, understanding listening texts
  * Practising grammatical structures (question formation, conditional sentences, comparison, relative clauses, tenses of present, past and future, modal verbs, passive, infinitives and gerunds, reported speech)
  * Improving writing skills (note taking, short essays, job applications, chart description, product and process descriptions, formal and informal correspondence)
  * Leading and participating in discussions

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Course participants should have good knowledge of English on level A2.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | none  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Exercise / 8 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 240 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * New Language Leader Intermediate
  * Additional material

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * 12 written tests (45 min each)
  * Every test accounts for one-twelfth of the final grade

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  |  _**College-Module - In case of failure no repetition possible!**__(see §7 paragraph 3 of Examination- and Study Regulation from 2018)_  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * 019001 Course Englisch - Mittelstufe (B1, Teil 1)

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
